what_this_is: How this character moves: its pose vocabulary, and for each kind of pose how the parts move and how they connect. Learned by watching reference videos of the character dancing (two Jimeng motion-imitation clips; their hallucinated feet are ignored). These are qualitative rules, not numbers: a new dance has new angles and timings, but the character should still move and connect this way. 'status' says whether the current rig and copy already do it.

parts.body: one soft bag of stuffing shaped like an egg: head and torso are a single piece, the face is on its upper front
parts.arms: two soft blue tubes with mitten hands, sewn onto the sides of the body; no elbow, no wrist
parts.hair: a big curly mop attached to the top and back of the head, hanging behind the body
parts.hands: flat mittens at the ends of the arms; they open (reaching, hanging) or ball up into fists (raised, bent, punching)

connections.shoulder: a socket on the side of the body. The arm turns in it like a plush toy's sewn-on arm; the body around it does not stretch or follow the arm.
connections.socket_slides: as an arm rises the socket slides up the side of the body: a hanging arm starts beside the chest, a raised arm starts beside the face. This is what lets raised hands reach above the head.
connections.arm_over_body: wherever the arm goes it passes in front: in front of the body when it crosses the chest, in front of the hair when it is raised. The joint itself is hidden behind the arm.
connections.hair_to_head: the hair stays on the scalp; only its lower part swings
connections.arm_faces_front: the arms are flattened tubes and the mitten hands are flat: whatever the arm does, the hand's flat face (palm or back) stays toward the viewer, so a raised arm shows its full width, never its thin edge; the arm turns in its forearm and hand for this, not at the seam
connections.arm_shape: an arm keeps its width and its length in every pose; it only bends. A small bend is a gentle curve along the whole arm; a big bend gathers in the middle like a soft elbow (a rounded L: upper part out to the side, forearm up), still round. When the body squashes, the arms do not
connections.arms_do_not_move_the_body: an arm moving, however far, never pulls or widens the body: the body's outline stays as it is
connections.body_soft: the body itself is soft and keeps its volume: when the body moves (a lean, a hip lift, a kick, a step, a landing) it bends into a smooth C or S curve; the inside of the bend is pressed together and bulges out a little, the outside stretches and straightens; the base stays on the floor except in a jump; the face and the heart ride on the surface
connections.back_is_hair: seen from behind the character is almost all hair; the arms show a little at the sides

poses.arms: hang down and a little out from the sides, hands open
straight out sideways from the socket, hand open or pointing
goes up from a socket that has slid up beside the face; straight or curving over the head; hand may ball up
poses.body: leans toward the raised arm, a moment after it moves; the body itself does not stretch

poses.arms: both straight up beside the face, in front of the hair, hands above the top of the head, often fists
curves around the front of the body, lying on it, hand reaching toward the other side
both bend forward and inward, hands meet in front of the chest
bend up in front of the body, hands cover the face or cheeks
the tube bends in its middle, the 'elbow' points out, hand comes back toward the body

poses.body: the whole egg turns on its base; small turns show the face moving across the body, big ones become a spin
poses.hair: swings out on the side it turns away from, then settles

poses.body: bobs up and down as a whole; squashes when low, stretches when high
the whole egg turns on its base past side-on to its back and round again
poses.hair: flies out to the side, then settles

poses.pose: both arms bent up (hands up, elbows out)
poses.arms: each arm goes out to the side and bends up in the middle like a soft elbow; hands beside or above the head, often fists
bent up in front of the body, fists beside the face
poses.body: upright, may lean back a little

poses.arms: the forearm lies across the front of the body, roughly level, the other arm out or down
poses.body: leans and turns toward the arm
squashes, bends into a curve: the top leans away from the leg, the side of the leg bulges a little
poses.arms: come in toward the body or out for balance

poses.body: bulges a little at the bottom and leans onto the supporting side, then back
the top leans one way while the bottom bulges the other way, like a pressed bag

dynamics: arms lead and carry the dance; the body supports them
the body follows the arms a moment later (leans toward the higher or moving arm)
hair trails the body and settles after the body stops
arms move in quick moves with short holds in between
the arms bend as smooth curves; raised arms straighten
the body squishes a little on every weight change (step, kick, landing) and springs back
turns can go all the way round; the hair flies out on fast turns
hands ball up when the arm is raised and bent, open again when it reaches out or drops

from_human.upper_arms_and_forearms: copy their direction as seen in the picture; the forearm becomes the bend of the soft arm
from_human.torso: copy the turn fully (the character can spin all the way round); copy side tilt and lean as bends of the soft body (a curve with a bulge), not only as rigid tilts
from_human.head: merged with the body: nods and tilts become small body tilts
from_human.legs, steps, kicks: no legs, so every leg movement is translated before anything else sees the motion (dancebuddy/legs.py): a jump becomes squash to wind up, stretch and a clear hop, squash on landing; a kick becomes a big lean away from the kicking leg with a small hop; a step becomes a small bob with a lean onto the stepping side; a squat becomes squash, rising on the toes a stretch; moving across the floor becomes a slide
from_human.hips: a hip lift bends the body into a C toward the lifted hip, the pressed side bulging; hip sway becomes a sideways shift with a small bend
from_human.hands: copy open or closed from the dancer's hand when it can be seen; otherwise fists for raised, bent arms and open hands for reaching

rig.file: plush_soft.blend, made by blender/rig_soft.py from plush.blend (the mesh is not edited)
rig.how: designed from the connections above; the mesh is not edited. Root at the base of the body; a hidden shoulder bone per arm (pivot just inside the seam) slides the seam up the body as the arm rises and takes half of the arm's turn; each arm is ONE 16-segment bendable bone (B-bone) with every arm point on it alone, so it bends as a curve and keeps its width (blender/check_arm_width.py checks this); only the seam blends with the shoulder; hair has no bones and moves with the head. Body weights are heat-diffusion weights from a closed voxel copy, copied back by position.

known_gaps: the texture has a shadow baked under each arm, which shows as a darker patch on the body side when the arm moves away
a raised arm's seam still shows a thin dark slit from the side
hands to the face and an arm across the whole chest do not reach as far as in the reference

done: arms keep width and length, bend as one curve, hands face the viewer
arms do not move the body
socket slides up as the arm rises
leg translation (jump, kick, step, squat, rise, slide)
soft body: side tilts are partly a C bend of the body, hip lifts bend it toward the lifted hip, hips swaying under the torso make an S, the bent lower body bulges (wider, shorter, same volume)
tilting on the base rises like a roly-poly toy, so the bottom never sinks into the floor
not_yet: spin: the body turn is limited (about 60 deg)
soft elbow for big arm bends: big bends are still one even curve
hair moves with the head only
